explanation.headline: Irinotecan hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale General has 22.3 days on hand and the top alternate is Actavis Pharma, Inc.

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows irinotecan hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 64 vials of the 20 mg/mL, 5 mL presentation with a daily use of 2.9 vials, giving 22.3 days on hand.
The rule ranks Actavis Pharma, Inc. as the first alternate manufacturer to buy from, noting it is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
Apotex Corp. and BluePoint Laboratories are ranked second and third as alternate manufacturers, also not on the shortage list and with labels naming no placeable plant.

A label for Northstar Rx LLC (NDC 16714013101) identifies Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604) as a registered plant for analysis and manufacture, last inspected with NAI classification on 2023-07-28.

FDA's shortage list also records Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC with a 'To Be Discontinued' status for irinotecan hydrochloride injection, initially posted 2026-02-24, citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture.

rejected.text: FDA inspection records for Gland Pharma Limited show three VAI classifications: inspection 848025 ending 2013-08-05, inspection 936901 ending 2015-06-30, and inspection 1110628 ending 2019-11-01.
rejected.reason: "three" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
